newsitem.title: UK: McDonald's plans 100 new restaurants in Britain this year.
newsitem.headline: McDonald's plans 100 new restaurants in Britain this year.

text.p: The British subsidiary of McDonald's Corp. said Thursday it planned to open more than 100 restaurants in Britain this year, creating at least 5,000 new full- or part-time jobs.
The expansion by McDonald's Restaurants Ltd. represents an investment of more than 116 million British pounds ($197 million) in land and buildings, the fast-food chain said in a statement.
The company said it would open about 38 more restaurants in southern England, 27 in the Midlands, 28 in the north, 12 in Scotland and five in Northern Ireland.
Last year McDonald's opened 90 new restaurants in Britain, creating some 4,500 new jobs.
McDonald's, which is based in Oak Brook, Ill., has said it plans to open more than 2,500 new restaurants worlwide this year.
